name: The Doors of the War Hall

A: Trophy armour from the king's challengers, polished to a shine.
G: The great doors of the war hall.

objects.name: Tallow
lines: Don't mind me. Torches. Every one lit, every hour, or it's the cage for Tallow.
The king likes it bright in there. No dark corners. Not even under him.

answer: Orders. Torches all round, mirrors behind them, so the king casts no shadow. A miracle, we're told.
A miracle with a very big lamp-oil bill, is all I'm saying.

questions.ask: Who's the tall one by the doors?
answer: Don't. He doesn't talk. Used to, they say. Nearly won, they say.
I light a torch for him too. Nobody told me to. Nobody told me not to.
Torches gutter. Even his. Especially if somebody's swinging a sword near them.
You didn't hear that from Tallow.

lines: Something grey and stitched unfolds from beside the doors. Taller than a man. Silent.
A tag hangs from its neck: AUREK THE TALL. Almost.
It raises a sword that isn't rusted at all.
